svg.title: ReCall: iterative recovery from function anchors
svg.desc: Take a known source and bundle function pair from the anchor set. Inspect both function neighborhoods. For an unmatched b′ function, rank seven source candidates by embedding similarity and keep five. Validate them in order: Candidate 3 and Candidate 1 fail, Candidate 6 passes. After conflict checks, add this new match to the anchor set for the next round. Blue arrows mean calls or function references, including imported calls. Dashed gray edges mean scope or proximity relationships. Neighborhood traversal is undirected.
svg.text: One anchor pair → paired neighborhoods → ranked candidates → validation → new anchor
Start from a known match; identify b′
F: try next · first T: stop
After conflict checks, at round end
Add the new match to the anchor set · next round
Neighborhood search traverses these relationships in both directions. With several nearby anchors, their source-neighbor pools are combined.
